The meticulous process of warping, where thousands of delicate silk threads are stretched taut and aligned with precision, forms the backbone of the village’s renowned silk production, embodying the aspirations for myriad good fortune encapsulated in the name "Vạn Phúc." Nestled in a sunlit corner of the workshop, the warping machine commands attention with its gleaming metallic structure and vibrant hues of silk.

This silent yet vital component of the silk-making process not only serves as a symbol of cultural heritage but also as a living museum piece, showcasing the timeless techniques that have been passed down through generations.
